messages:
samir_sales: FYI customer returned redline: a broad MFN tied to any "publicly posted price", a 12-month price freeze, and a promo cap of $0.011/token for marketing. POC is on deck next week. Need quick callout of commercial risks and a counter. 

```text
MFN: Provider will match the most favorable publicly posted price for substantially similar services.
Price Freeze: No increases for 12 months.
Promo Cap: Any public promotion shall not exceed $0.011/token.
```

samir_sales: @jo_dealdesk @emma_legal @noah_se @olivia_revops urgently. They want confirmation before POC start.

jo_dealdesk: Broad MFN + 12mo lock = materially restricts pricing ops. My suggested approach: 1) Limit MFN to offers >=45 days and to customers with materially comparable committed spend and API package. 2) Exclude marketplace, reseller, partner-funded promos and trial credits. 3) Convert unconditional freeze into a prepaid hosted commit that sets discount bands.

emma_legal: I'll draft a counter: MFN scoped to "sustained commercial offers" (>=45 days), carve-outs for transient promos (<$25k), beta and partner deals, and explicit exclusion of third-party surcharges. Also add no-retro clause for past promos.

oah_se: Technical: POC has high burst traffic and will skew token baseline. We should tie MFN to committed units (or revenue bands) and include a POC true-up: if actual usage > projected by 25% we reserve rights to bill overage rates or re-evaluate discounts.

olivia_revops: For pricing bands, propose hosted-prepay tiers: $60k (10% off), $180k (18% off), $400k (26% off). If customer refuses commit >=$180k, limit any price hold to 90 days. Need revops sign-off on those bands.

jo_dealdesk: Good. Also push that promo caps below the committed-discounted effective price are disallowed; we will not accept promotional pricing that undermines the economics of the committed tier. Provide their team with an effective price example.

oah_se: Example calc: list = $0.02/token. With $180k commit at 18% off => $0.0164/token. A $0.011 promo would reduce revenue by ~33% on high volume; unsustainable for sustained campaigns.
\em ma_legal: I'll circulate a redline by EOD with the scoped MFN, carve-outs, POC true-up, and commit-based price hold.

samir_sales: Thanks all 44d I'll tell the customer we're preparing a counter and need a verbal on commit bands to greenlight POC.

olivia_revops: Looped in revops for approvals. I'll confirm by EOD.

samir_sales: Holding POC scheduling until we have a verbal on commit bands and signed redline.
